desc.en: Francis strikes an enemy with her medical chart, dealing Physical DMG. / [Tag-out Skill] When switched out, she reviews the chart to trigger On-the-Fly Diagnosis. This effect does not stack with other On-the-Fly Diagnosis effects. / [Support Skill] When a teammate's HP falls to 75% or below, Francis appears by their side and deals Earth DMG, inflicts Earth Affliction on an enemy, and heals the teammate based on her ATK.

name.en: Do You Need a New Prescription?

desc.en: Upon switching to another teammate, the new character's HP is restored by 20.5% of Francis's ATK.

note.en: the new character · 20.5% of Francis's ATK
